Opera's browser now runs AI on your laptop 🧠 WebAI, 27 Oct 2026:

1️⃣ WebAI is a proposed web standard (Opera says Google and Microsoft back it) that lets sites and extensions use AI models running on your device.
2️⃣ It comes with 3 APIs: Prompt, Decision and Semantic Embeddings. No API key, no separate app.
3️⃣ Opera says page data can stay on your device, and developers skip per-request cloud fees.
4️⃣ It ships with 6 demo extensions, like a quiz on the article you just read.
5️⃣ Early preview in Opera One on Windows 64-bit and Apple silicon Macs, opt-in. Not on Intel Macs, Linux or Windows on Arm.

Our take: local AI is the privacy pitch, but speed depends on your hardware. 🤔
